# MedAce-AI: AI-Powered MDCAT Preparation Platform

## Project Introduction

MedAce-AI is a comprehensive AI-powered educational platform designed specifically for Pakistani students preparing for the Medical and Dental College Admission Test (MDCAT). The application provides personalized study assistance through intelligent quiz generation, performance tracking, and adaptive learning recommendations—all delivered in Urdu to ensure accessibility for local students.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Personalized Learning**: Generate customized quizzes based on individual student performance and weak areas
- **AI-Driven Content**: Leverage Google's Gemini AI to create high-quality, syllabus-aligned questions in Urdu
- **Performance Analytics**: Track progress, identify weak topics, and provide actionable insights
- **Study Planning**: Generate adaptive weekly study plans based on performance data
- **Accessibility**: Full Urdu interface supporting right-to-left text direction

### Target Audience
- Pakistani medical aspirants preparing for MDCAT
- Students seeking personalized, AI-enhanced study assistance
- Learners who prefer content in Urdu language

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern Next.js 16 architecture with client-side rendering patterns, implementing a clean separation between UI components, business logic, and API endpoints.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Next.js App Router] --> B[Auth Layer]
    A --> C[Dashboard Layout]
    A --> D[Quiz System]
    
    B --> E[Supabase Auth]
    C --> F[React Query State]
    C --> G[Custom Hooks]
    
    D --> H[useQuizSession Hook]
    D --> I[API Routes]
    I --> J[Google Gemini API]
    
    F --> K[Local Storage]
    G --> L[UI Components]
    L --> M[Tailwind CSS]
```

### Component Breakdown

The application is structured around several key architectural layers:

**Presentation Layer**: React components organized by feature domains (auth, dashboard, quiz, layout)
**Business Logic Layer**: Custom hooks managing complex state and API interactions
**Data Access Layer**: API routes handling external service integrations
**Infrastructure Layer**: Authentication, database, and AI service providers

### Design Patterns

- **Component Composition**: Reusable UI components with clear prop interfaces
- **State Management**: React Query for server state, custom hooks for client state
- **Route Groups**: Organized routing structure separating public and protected routes
- **Provider Pattern**: Context-based authentication and query management

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Root Layout Configuration** (`src/app/layout.tsx`)
- Sets up RTL (right-to-left) support for Urdu language
- Wraps application with global providers (QueryProvider, AuthProvider)
- Configures metadata for SEO optimization

**Authentication Flow** (`src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx`)
- Provides dedicated layout for authentication pages
- Centers auth forms with responsive design
- Handles unauthenticated user access control

**Dashboard Layout** (`src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`)
- Implements responsive sidebar navigation
- Manages mobile navigation drawer
- Enforces authentication guards for protected routes

### Core Modules

**Quiz Session Management** (`src/lib/hooks/useQuizSession.ts`)
- Manages complete quiz lifecycle from setup to completion
- Handles timer functionality and answer tracking
- Coordinates with API endpoints for question generation
- Maintains session state including progress and timing data

**AI Integration** (`src/lib/gemini/client.ts`)
- Interfaces with Google Gemini API for question generation
- Implements prompt engineering for MDCAT-specific content
- Handles response parsing and error management
- Supports multiple AI functions: question generation, explanations, study planning

**Authentication System** (`src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx`)
- Wraps Supabase authentication in React context
- Manages user sessions and authentication state
- Provides sign-out functionality
- Handles authentication state changes reactively

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Setup** (`package.json`)
- Modern Next.js 16 with React 19
- Tailwind CSS v4 for styling
- Supabase for authentication and database
- Google Gemini API for AI capabilities
- TanStack Query for data fetching and caching

**Database Schema** (`drizzle.config.ts`)
- Drizzle ORM for type-safe database operations
- PostgreSQL database integration
- Migration management for schema evolution

### External Dependencies

**Core Framework**: Next.js 16 with App Router
**Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom theme configuration
**State Management**: Zustand for client state, React Query for server state
**Authentication**: Supabase for user management and session handling
**AI Integration**: Google Gemini API for content generation
**Database**: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM for type safety

### Integration Points

**Google Gemini API** (`src/lib/gemini/client.ts`)
- Generates MDCAT questions in Urdu
- Creates personalized explanations
- Develops adaptive study plans
- Handles rate limiting and error recovery

**Supabase Authentication** (`src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx`)
- User registration and login
- Session management
- Protected route access control
- User profile management

**File Structure Organization**:
```
src/
├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages
│   ├── (auth)/            # Authentication routes
│   ├── (dashboard)/       # Protected dashboard routes
│   └── api/              # API route handlers
├── components/            # Reusable UI components
├── lib/                  # Business logic and utilities
├── providers/            # React context providers
└── types/               # TypeScript type definitions
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Intelligent Quiz Generation**
- Dynamic question creation based on selected topics and difficulty levels
- Adaptive difficulty adjustment based on user performance
- Comprehensive explanations in Urdu for each question
- Real-time progress tracking and timing analysis

**Performance Analytics Dashboard**
- Visual representation of quiz results and progress trends
- Weak topic identification and targeted improvement suggestions
- Study streak tracking and motivation features
- Recent activity monitoring and session history

**Adaptive Study Planning**
- AI-generated weekly study schedules based on performance data
- Personalized topic prioritization focusing on weak areas
- Flexible scheduling accommodating different study habits
- Progress tracking within the generated study plan

### Implementation Highlights

**Quiz System** (`src/components/quiz/`)
- Modular quiz components with clear separation of concerns
- Real-time timer and progress indicators
- Interactive answer selection with immediate feedback
- Comprehensive result visualization with detailed analytics

**State Management** (`src/lib/hooks/`)
- Custom hooks encapsulating complex business logic
- Efficient state synchronization between client and server
- Error handling and loading states management
- Optimized re-renders through selective state updates

**Responsive Design** (`src/components/ui/`)
- Mobile-first approach with adaptive layouts
- Consistent component library with reusable UI elements
- Accessibility considerations for diverse user needs
- Performance optimizations for smooth user experience

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle: Application Start
    Idle --> Loading: Start Quiz
    Loading --> Active: Questions Generated
    Active --> Reviewing: Answer Selected
    Reviewing --> Active: Next Question
    Reviewing --> Finished: Last Question
    Active --> Finished: All Questions Complete
    Finished --> Idle: Restart Quiz
    
    note right of Loading
        Fetches questions from
        Google Gemini API
    end note
    
    note right of Reviewing
        Shows explanation and
        tracks performance metrics
    end note
```

The MedAce-AI platform represents a sophisticated educational technology solution that combines AI capabilities with modern web development practices to deliver personalized, accessible learning experiences for MDCAT preparation. The architecture emphasizes scalability, maintainability, and user experience while providing a solid foundation for future enhancements and feature additions.
